Errors in rearranging gravitational equations and isolating variables for orbital calculations

Misunderstanding how gravitational field strength varies with distance squared
Conflating field strength (N/kg) with gravitational force (N) and applying them interchangeably
Incorrect sign convention for gravitational potential energy and potential near massive bodies
Believing weightlessness in orbit means zero gravity rather than free-fall conditions
Rote application of v = sqrt(GM/r) and Kepler's third law without conceptual derivation or understanding

Ready for advanced problems combining field superposition, energy methods, and orbital transfer analysis
Ready for cross-domain synthesis comparing gravitational and electric field concepts
